author: Channel 5 with Andrew Callaghan
description:
Here's yesterday's coverage of the Charlie Kirk memorial event in Times Square, which commemorated the one year anniversary of his assassination. Pulled an all-nighter editing this from scratch, so I hope you guys like it - Andrew 

Also, to see 'Al Oeste, En Zapata' and a number of other films while directly supporting creators, head over to our new streaming platform, https://c5.now .. available on Roku, Smart TV, iOs and web browser!
title: The Kirkiversary
